description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_phone' that formats phone numbers as clickable 'tel:' links in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes licensing comments, safeguards against direct access, and the plugin implementation.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_phone
methods.description: Formats a phone number as a 'tel:' link if 'value' parameter is provided, otherwise triggers an error.
